research_question: Can contrastive preference optimization improve ambiguous-intent clarification beyond a native-ChatML prompt-only baseline without regressing other routing categories?
prerequisites: Create at least 200 human-reviewed preference cases with chosen clarify outputs and action-specific rejected outputs.
Group splits by ambiguity template family, entity, and image fixture.
Create a sealed test split that is not used for prompt or checkpoint selection.
Prohibit exact prompt/completion repetition as a substitute for data diversity.
promotion_gate: Clarify accuracy improves with a case-clustered 95% interval above zero, and no critical category regresses by more than 0.02.
